question: Which key reform in 1991 specifically addressed the inefficiency of public sector enterprises and promoted competition in industrial production?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Privatization of profit-making PSUs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **1991 Economic Reforms** in India were a watershed moment in addressing the inefficiencies and bureaucratic bottlenecks of the economy.
 
• **Privatization** involved transferring ownership of public sector enterprises to private hands to increase **efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.**
